nodes.name: RA Launcher Trigger
nodes.notes: MCP/SUB-WORKFLOW ENTRY POINT - launches the applicable Research Agent jobs for a case. Normally called by CAR Trigger MCP.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.case_id, c.applicant_id, c.applicant_type, c.licence_target, c.primary_contact_name, c.primary_contact_email, c.folder_root_id, c.folder_url, c.intake_data, COALESCE(json_agg(cd.metadata) FILTER (WHERE cd.status = 'received' AND cd.metadata IS NOT NULL), '[]'::json) AS received_documents
FROM car_cases c
LEFT JOIN car_case_documents cd ON cd.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.case_id = $1
GROUP BY c.case_id
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Postgres: Load Case Context
nodes.notes: CASE CONTEXT - loads applicant metadata, folder references, intake JSON, and received document metadata for RA prompt payloads.

nodes.name: Code: Determine Required RAs
nodes.notes: RA ROUTER - chooses the RA set from applicant_type unless MCP provides an override list. Emits one item per RA job.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO car_case_ra (case_id, agent, status, report_json)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'launched', jsonb_build_object('launched_at', now(), 'launched_by', $3::text, 'skill_path', $4::text, 'output_md_path', $5::text, 'output_json_path', $6::text, 'runner_configured', $7::boolean, 'launch_notes', $8::text))
ON CONFLICT (case_id, agent) DO UPDATE
SET status = CASE WHEN $9::boolean THEN 'launched' ELSE car_case_ra.status END,
    report_json = COALESCE(car_case_ra.report_json, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('last_launch_at', now(), 'last_launched_by', $3::text, 'skill_path', $4::text, 'output_md_path', $5::text, 'output_json_path', $6::text, 'runner_configured', $7::boolean, 'launch_notes', $8::text),
    completed_at = CASE WHEN $9::boolean THEN NULL ELSE car_case_ra.completed_at END
RETURNING
  id AS ra_record_id,
  case_id,
  agent,
  status AS persisted_status,
  $10::text AS applicant_id,
  $11::text AS applicant_type,
  $12::text AS applicant_name,
  $13::text AS applicant_email,
  $14::text AS licence_target,
  $15::text AS folder_root_id,
  $16::text AS folder_url,
  $17::text AS signal_type,
  $18::text AS skill_path,
  $19::text AS output_base_path,
  $20::text AS output_md_path,
  $21::text AS output_json_path,
  $22::text AS runner_url,
  $23::boolean AS runner_configured,
  $24::text AS launched_by,
  $25::text AS launch_notes;

nodes.name: Postgres: Record RA Launch
nodes.notes: LAUNCH AUDIT - upserts car_case_ra as launched. If force_relaunch is false, existing completed records are not cleared.

nodes.name: Code: Restore Launch Payload
nodes.notes: PAYLOAD RESTORE - Postgres returns audit fields only, so this re-attaches the RA runner payload for downstream branching.

nodes.name: IF: Runner URL Configured?
nodes.notes: RUNNER GATE - true branch calls the configured RA runner URL. False branch records/announces manual launch required.

nodes.notes: EXTERNAL RA RUNNER CALL - posts one RA job to the configured runner. Runner should call /webhook/car-ra-completion when finished.
